newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Gold closes unchanged in H.K. from New York levels.
newsitem.headline: Gold closes unchanged in H.K. from New York levels.

text.p: Hong Kong gold closed unchanged on Friday from New York's overnight finish at US$341.30/80 an ounce after trading within a 50 cent range in extremely quiet trading, dealers said.
"The local market was narrowly mixed in cautious trade today," a senior dealer at a local investment house said.
"But the stronger U.S. dollar triggered selling interest on gold. Gold is expected to soften and may test support at US$340 levels in the short-term," he added.
Local gold ended HK$4 lower at HK$3,161 a tael.
The carry over charge at the Chinese Gold and Silver Exchange Society remained unchanged at -5.50.
